retry_rule.permitted_only_when: The recorded attempt has a non-null transport or provider error; UNPARSED and valid model outputs are never retried.
retry_rule.provenance: Every attempt remains append-only. Any retry used in analysis requires an amended, hashed manifest selecting the exact attempt ID before target execution.

saturation_rule.boundary: For each reader, if either target arm executes below 10% or above 90%, label that reader result instrument-boundary evidence.
saturation_rule.claim_effect: Saturation does not convert a null or significant contrast into evidence for the causal claim.

success_rule.direction: simple-present minus progressive EXECUTE risk difference is positive
success_rule.multiplicity: Two-sided exact McNemar tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction across exactly three reader configurations.
success_rule.required: Positive Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 in at least two of three readers, with no Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 reversal in the third.
success_rule.summary: No pooled significance test. Report the finite-item paired estimand, discordances, intervals or sensitivity bounds, all errors, and descriptive frame/source-form splits.

user_authorization.scope: After writing, implement and run the downstream design precisely, using faster Terra coding agents under primary-agent oversight, and update the documentation.
